title: Five Stages of Accepting Constructive Mathematics - Andrej Bauer
summary: Andrej Bauer's IAS talk introduces constructive mathematics and what it feels like to do mathematics without excluded middle. It is framed as a tour for classical mathematicians.
why: Pointed to as a well-done introduction to constructive mathematics when it comes up in logic and proof assistant threads.

quote.text: Here are two versions of the same well-done talk, from Andrej Bauer
